note: Placed pieces (docs 09, docs/future/10; src/world/pieces): objects that rest on the ground rather than being part of it. The first is the loose stone, the naturalist's reward at six finds (naturalist.json). cap: how many loose stones an island may hold; at the cap the Loose stone mode says so calmly and sets no more. sizeM: a stone's length in meters [min, max], picked by its seed. sink: the share of a stone's height set into the ground, so it sits rather than rests. lean: how much of the ground's slope a stone leans with (0 level, 1 flat on the slope). grassClear: blades stand no nearer a stone's middle than this share of its half length (src/render/passes/grass.js clears), so it sits in the grass rather than the grass growing through it. tapM and tapPerM: how near a tap must be to pick a stone (plus this much per meter of camera distance; never less than about half the stone's length). arrive: when the reward is given, count stones come by themselves on grounds (painted grass or soil) between nearM [min, max] meters from fresh water (a pond or stream, never the sea or a damp hollow), never in water, on ground no steeper than maxSlope (rise over run across a meter), at least spacingM apart; placed from the world seed, so live play and catch-up give the same stones. tip: a tap on a stone lifts its near edge by tipDeg over tipS seconds (pivoting on the far edge, so you see underneath), holds for holdS, then settles back over settleS. shape: the stones are baked from blended ellipsoids (src/world/creatures/body-bake.js): count shapes, seeded from seed; widthShare and heightShare [min, max] of the length; lobes extra lumps blended in by blendM; cellM the bake grid; then cut by facets: a top plane tilted up to topTilt and cutting at topShare [min, max] of the stone's reach upward (a flatter top), and chips planes round the shoulders, rising chipUp [min, max] and cutting at chipShare of the reach that way. albedo: weathered grey stone (linear, darker than fresh rock, in the island rock's own hue); underside: damp and soil-stained where it lies in the ground; mottle: broad and fine tone wander (shares) at broadPerUnit and finePerUnit waves per mesh unit, and hue a touch warmer or cooler with the broad patches. The draw pass (src/shaders/piece-draw.wgsl) lays the island's scanned rock over this, triplanar in the stone's frame: its variation about the rock's mean (terrain.json albedoRock), its normals (look.normalStrength) and roughness. Albedos are physical; the palette paints at tonemap (docs/05). damp: the dark patch the stone leaves on the ground, as a share of its footprint (scale), with its albedo at the middle and edge (linear). ring: the soft damp darkening of the ground round each stone's foot: darkness 0..1, scale over the footprint. words: the Loose stone mode's calm lines (full at the cap, water when a tap lands in water).

words.full: The island holds all the loose stones it can for now. Remove one to set it somewhere else.
words.water: A loose stone sits on land. Tap the ground.
